headline: New US AI Chip Export Rules Create Uncertainty for Southeast Asian Markets
summary: New US restrictions on AI chip exports are causing concern in Southeast Asia, threatening billions in regional investment. Countries in the region face challenges balancing economic ties between Washington and Beijing.
why: Southeast Asia has become a critical hub for semiconductor assembly and testing. Changes in US trade policy regarding high-end technology exports directly impact the regional supply chain and foreign direct investment flows.

impacts.name: Semiconductor Industry
impacts.why: Export restrictions disrupt the global supply chain for high-end AI chips.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Trade restrictions on critical technology components create supply chain volatility and geopolitical risk, which typically triggers market caution in affected manufacturing hubs.
